app_events.details: Rider R-5288 booked trip RYDE-PS-002 from Tuas Link MRT to Orchard Central.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$80.00 with 1 photo and a cleaning receipt.
Receipt attached: Sparkle Auto Care, Ubi Ave 1, S$80.00, dated 2026-10-05 19:10.
S$80.00 cleaning fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_tiers.value: food or drink spill up to S$40; stains (mud, dirt) and bodily fluids up to S$120; vomit up to S$200
cleaning_fee_tiers.text: Usual fee by type of mess; a fee above the tier for the mess type needs a receipt.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.value: photo of the mess and a cleaning receipt where available
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt, a case officer decides; the fee is neither confirmed nor removed automatically.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

evidence.description: Mud and clay on the rear floor mat, taken right after drop-off at Orchard Central.

expected_outcome.reason: The driver's photo was taken at 17:12, 14 min after the 16:58 drop-off (inside the 60-minute window), at GPS (1.3019, 103.8460), about 120 m from the drop-off at Orchard Central, and shows mud on the floor mat. The driver reported the mud in chat at 17:00 and a receipt for S$80 (dated 2026-10-05) is attached; S$80 is within the S$120 stain tier and the S$200 cap. The rider's own words ('a bit of dust') admit dirt and give no ground such as pre-existing damage. The fee stands; refund S$0.

Ryde Help Driver Ryde Experience > My Rider Made a Mess

v21_change.why: Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 s4.4: a rider disputes a cleaning or damage claim (routed to human review); s6.1: the dispute value is above S$50 (always human review). The automatic ruling before v2.1 is kept under 'was' (D50).
